{{Quote|Mesa so happy Fetta send yousa to mesa. Moa Bounty Hunter after mesa for mysa veiws'' {{C|sic}} ''polictica. Makea himsa deada. Soris isa hisa namea.|Nalskel|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Nalskel''' was an up-and-coming [[Otolla/Legends|Otolla]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], political opponents in the [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire]] sent a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Soris]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Nalskel. However, Nalskel's life was saved when the infamous [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] sent a contact of his to work for the politician. This contact, who was learning the ways of bounty hunting, killed Soris and several of his followers, allowing Nalskel's political career within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] administration to continue unhindered.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Yousa got mesa Death Mark back! Nowsa mesa political career can take off. Mesa going to the Imperial adminstration.|Nalskel|<ref name="SWG" />}}
Nalskel was an [[Otolla/Legends|Otolla]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] of the lush [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Nalskel's political career began to flourish. However, his political views were not well liked by his opponents, particularly those in [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire]]. In order to halt the Gungan politician's rising success, they commissioned a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Soris]] with [[Death/Legends|killing]] Nalskel.<ref name="SWG" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
However, Nalskel's ambitions could not be stopped so easily. The infamous [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] became aware of Nalskel's plight and sent a novice bounty hunter to help resolve the politician's dilemma. Thrilled that Fett had sent him help, Nalskel quickly put the novice bounty hunter to work. Thanks to Naskel's associates, the bounty hunter learned that Soris was away on business. To take advantage of Soris' absence, Nalskel sent the bounty hunter to the Nikto's camp outside of Naboo's [[Ocean/Legends|oceanside]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kaadara]]. Searching for clues, the bounty hunter succeeded in locating Soris' [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], which contained detailed information regarding Soris' allegiance with the Nal Raka Criminal Empire.<ref name="SWG" />

To teach Borvo a lesson, Nalskel sent the bounty hunter to another camp outside of Kaadara, occupied not only by Borvo's henchmen, but Soris himself. The bounty hunter first started by killing at least fifteen of Borvo's underlings, before turning toward Soris. Deducing that Soris had no friends left, Nalskel ordered the bounty hunter via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to approach Soris, hand him his [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]], and kill him. Motivated by the promise of compensation, the bounty hunter cornered Soris and handed over the death mark given to him by Nalskel&mdash;a [[tombstone]] inscribed in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] with the words, "Rest in Peace. In Loving Memory." The bounty hunter then executed Soris, much to Nalskel's delight, who now felt that his political career could blossom unhindered. After the bounty hunter received his payment in [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], Nalskel mused over his next step, going to the Imperial administration.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Soris himsa has nosa friends left. Give Soris death mark and killsa him moua moua dead.|Nalskel|<ref name="SWG" />}}
[[File:SorisCamp.jpg|230px|thumb|The camp in which Soris' datapad was discovered]]
Nalskel belonged to a lineage of the Gungan [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the Otolla. Like many Otolla Gungans, Nalskel had [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and orange, mottled skin. Nalskel also spoke a strongly accented form of [[Gungan (language)|Gunganese]],<ref name="SWG" /> a [[Language/Legends|language]] derived from the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] settlers' language, [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="GPBTG">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>

Nalskel was ambitious in his effort to advance his political agenda and ruthless in his mission to eliminate his political opponents. As evidenced by his cooperation with the bounty hunter sent by Boba Fett, Nalskel had no qualms with killing Soris and enacting revenge against Borvo's criminal empire. Nalskel also insisted on the macabre gesture of handing Soris a death mark in the form of a tombstone before having him killed. Still, Nalskel exhibited a cheerful demeanor. He was very thankful to Fett and the novice bounty hunter who saved his life.<ref name="SWG" />

==Equipment==
During his political career, Nalskel wore a [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] similar in appearance to those of the [[Militiagung/Legends|militiagung]],<ref name="SWG" /> [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]].<ref name="SW-Visual">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Nalskel was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Nalskel was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]" update,<ref name="SWG" /> released on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> If a player chose to pursue the [[W:c:swg:Bounty Hunter|bounty hunter]] [[W:c:swg:Profession|profession]], the player would receive an [[W:c:swg:Arrest Warrant|arrest warrant]] item when reaching [[W:c:swg:Combat level|Level 26]]. By using this item, players would begin an optional [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] that involved working with Boba Fett to save the Gungan Nalskel from Soris the bounty hunter. This article assumes that the player was a novice bounty hunter, which was the intended recipient of the arrest warrant item.<ref name="SWG" />

The [[Star Wars video games|game's]] directory tree files contain details for a follow-up quest that never made it onto the live [[W:c:swg:Server|servers]]. In this quest, the player discovers that a rival politician, a man named [[Charde (politician)|Charde]], directly hired Soris to kill Nalskel. Upon learning this information, Nalskel asks the player to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Charde. The directory files also reveal that Nalskel was an up-and-coming politician of [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]], a small town on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TRE">{{GalaxiesNGE}} data files: c_bounty_hunter_kill_3.stf and c_bounty_hunter_kill_4.stf</ref>
